item.title: Version 1.3.5
item.description:
Surge Browser 1.3.5

Read the web in your language, and keep more of what you type to yourself.

  • Page translation is back, built in. When you open a page in another language, Surge offers to translate it, powered by Google Translate. A page's text goes to Google only when you choose Translate.
  • Your forms stay private. Surge no longer sends the structure of the forms you fill in to Google for autofill. Your saved addresses and passwords still fill in as before.
